description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for gathering and managing system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registration, device ID retrieval, updating system info, and notifying registered observers.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents network-related information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Holds location data including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Provides device identification details such as identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface, or the first available MAC address if no interface name is provided.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls the Updated method on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets the internet info based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Security::Set
methods.description: Sets the security info based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Location::Set
methods.description: Sets location info based on provided data.
